correctness.rationale: Symmetric traceless matrix decomposition into zonal scalar, meridional vector and tangential traceless quadratic gives three exact normalized latitude Gram eigenvalue bands lambda0/lambda1/lambda2 with multiplicities 1,d−1,(d−2)(d+1)/2. Global smallest-eigenvalue optimum has left intersection z_- and right z_+, with L_d decreasing and R_d increasing in d, equality d4; all d3-∞ follow. Independent generalized moment Gram eigenproblems and sampled optimizers corroborate; finite tests are not infinite proofs.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate rather than prove unbounded claims.
